issues.description: The user is being redirected to the /auth page instead of being shown step-3b. The URL is /auth?next=%2Fdesign%2Fstep-3b, meaning the auth middleware is blocking unauthenticated access to /design/step-3b and forcing a sign-in. The step-3b page never renders.
issues.element: Entire page — showing /auth instead of /design/step-3b style blend confirmation screen
issues.root_cause: The route /design/step-3b is protected by authentication middleware (likely apps/web/middleware.ts or similar). When an unauthenticated user (or the QA agent) navigates to /design/step-3b, they are redirected to /auth?next=%2Fdesign%2Fstep-3b. The step-3b page itself cannot be evaluated until either auth is bypassed for QA or a valid session exists.
